Ahead of the tournament's main draw beginning on Sunday, 30 August, the Italian confirmed that he would not be taking part in the final grand slam of the year. "Even though I have been working hard with my team and my medical staff, we have now had to make the difficult decision that I will not be able to compete at the US Open this year," the 25-year-old posted on Instagram announcing the decision. The 25-year-old has been out of action since winning and retaining the Wimbledon men's singles title, his first and only major win of the year. His exact injury, and the severity of it, has now been revealed while viewers tune into a quieter tournament also without Emma Raducanu and Brazilian sensation Joao Fonseca.
